brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor — discrepancy 14 days old. Luke signed; microbial results, batch-record conflicts and lot-specific shipment traceability remain unresolved. Aaron/Evelyn need an authorized disposition. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both Silk lots, actual shipments, microbial results and batch records with Sam today; record authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Get existing COAs into Evelyn’s hands. Luke/Roon QC is blocked. Existing FSS/LC documents are located, but Evelyn’s receipt, physical-lot match and QA acceptance remain unverified. November 25 request is two days old; no fixed deadline stated. Send internally: Evelyn and Ron, match Heather’s November 19 FSS COAs and the existing Lotioncrafter originals to physical lots today, then record Evelyn’s receipt and QA disposition without requesting duplicates.

ACT NOW 3: Roon — four days to requested December 1 run. Complaint disposition and actual approved R7 test timing remain unverified. A new full-week test today cannot finish before December 1; the run is not PLL-approved. Sticker/capper shipment is out for delivery, not received or qualified. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, review complaints with Sam today, verify the actual R7 test start and approved full-week plan, and reconcile QC, materials and equipment before any December 1 commitment.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk’s lot disposition first, then complete the existing COA handoff and settle Roon’s test-versus-run decision.

Scheduled: Four calendar events through Tuesday morning; nearest Monday November 30 at 9:30 AM Eastern, tentative. Ecolab 11:00 AM overlaps one tentative meeting—resolve the conflict. CRM: 20 active tasks, 13 overdue, five future-dated, two undated; none dated due within 48 hours.
Noise: 18 of 22 new inbound messages suppressed; four assessed. Lower-ranked operational items remain tracked, not cleared.
Hunter remains displaced, not cleared: the direct COA handoff can unblock two live jobs; Hunter’s November 24 audit outcome is unverified, and first status due November 20 is seven days old.

WhatsApp remains signed out; relink from Aidan’s phone. Older unread coverage is partial. No sends, forwarding, spending or operational edits; no QA or production release inferred. FSS filenames matched, not PDF contents or physical lots.
signal: Protect controlled release and unblock existing QC before buying or promising production.
